features.name: Three bonus rounds

review:
Steampunk airships and floating cities on a 5x4 paylines grid. It's rated medium volatility – one of Hacksaw's gentler games. Green gas canisters upgrade themselves and nearby low symbols or wilds into something better, and other canisters feed explosive wilds.

The three bonus rounds add sticky wild multipliers, so a wild that lands early keeps paying all round. 10,000x max in every mode. A great pick for longer demo sessions if you want Hacksaw's style without the extreme swings.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
